g.text: Each cell compares the tariff fence (August 2026 Census duty plus AD/CVD) with the
recommended choice written in it: 12 aligned, 17 tax trusted partners, 16 sit above the
recommended height and 1 is below it. Re-run on the statutory regime of 4 December 2026
(incl. Proclamation 11052 and the new AD/CVD deposits): no verdict changes.
Only 12 of 46 electro-industrial tariff fences match the
Rules (Trade Restrictiveness Index): Secure needs 15% or more on coercive suppliers and under 5% on trusted ones. Preserve,
Catch Up, Partner and Accelerate keep the gate open: trusted partners under 5%, so a cell that fences coercive suppliers is
still misaligned if trusted partners pay 5% or more. Watch implies a low fence: all suppliers under 5%.
Not assessed: Wind extraction (no posture) and Nuclear recovery (no trade). –: no traded basket goods. Deployment is scored on
Source: NEIS analysis of US Census Bureau imports for consumption and calculated duty by HTS-10 line and partner (via the Trade
War Tracker, github.com/tradewartracker), Commerce AD/CVD notices in the Federal Register.
